raw.rationale: A pan-BCL2/BCL-xL/BCL-w inhibitor at 2.5 µM for 5 days should selectively kill lineages dependent on anti-apoptotic BCL2 family proteins, notably BCL2-driven lymphoid malignancies and BCL-xL-dependent small-cell lung cancer, but the PRISM lineages listed are mostly solid tumors with low baseline selectivity; published PRISM data for BCL inhibitors show selective activity mainly in hematologic lineages not listed here, so probabilities are low across these solid-tumor lineages.
